FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet revolutionary change is unfolding.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a stately figure with a well-groomed beard, sits upon his throne. He gazes out the window, his eyes fixed on the horizon. Suddenly, a faint hum fills the air, like the gentle buzzing of a harp string.

KING EVERARD
(to his advisor, Lord Ravenswood)
I have a vision, my friend. A new era for our empire. One that blends the grandeur of our past with the...the... (he searches for the right words)...the futurism of the unknown.

LORD RAVENSWOOD
(nervously)
If it pleases Your Majesty, what did you have in mind?

KING EVERARD
(leaning forward)
I want our aesthetic to be... (he pauses, as if conjuring a word from the ether)...neon-lit. Yes, that's it. Neon lights will illuminate our streets, casting a gaudy glow over our cities.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

A team of artisans, clad in worn leather aprons, busily construct a series of neon-lit sculptures. They resemble twisted, organic forms, as if born from the very essence of the castle's stone walls.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard's advisors gather around a large, ornate mirror. They watch in awe as the king's advisors, dressed in attire that blends medieval finery with futuristic flair, begin to dance. Their movements are stiff, yet somehow... (the camera lingers on a particularly awkward step)...futuristic.

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
Behold, my friends! The fusion of our empire's heritage with the...the... (he searches for the right words again)...the cyberpunk of the future!

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

As the sun sets, the castle walls come alive with a kaleidoscope of neon lights. The colors dance and swirl, casting an otherworldly glow over the landscape.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. They gaze upon a large, glowing screen, displaying a mesmerizing pattern of 8-bit graphics and distorted, VHS-style footage.

KING EVERARD
(leaning back in his throne)
This, my friends, is the future of our empire. A future where the boundaries between past and present are blurred, and the very fabric of reality is... (he pauses, a sly grin spreading across his face)...disrupted.

FADE TO BLACK.
